author: Vertyco
description: Sell your server's economy credits through GlassRelay. Buyers pay on your GlassRelay store and get credits at a rate you set.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the Discord IDs of buyers and the GlassRelay payments credited to them. These purchase records are kept for the server's bookkeeping when a user asks for their data to be deleted.
install_msg: Thank you for installing GlassRelay! Type `[p]help GlassRelay` to get started.
